scripts.build: pnpm run build:common && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:preload && pnpm run build:renderer
scripts.build:pack: cross-env MODE=production npm run build && electron-builder build --config .electron-builder.config.js
scripts.compile:all: cross-env MODE=production npm run build && electron-builder build --config .electron-builder.config.js --dir
scripts.compile:mac: cross-env MODE=production npm run build && electron-builder --mac --config .electron-builder.config.js --dir
scripts.compile:win: cross-env MODE=production npm run build && electron-builder --win --config .electron-builder.config.js
scripts.compile:win32: cross-env MODE=production npm run build && electron-builder --win --ia32 --config .electron-builder.config.js
scripts.release:mac:arm64: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env MODE=production pnpm run build && dotenv -e .env -- electron-builder --mac --arm64 --config .electron-builder.config.js --publish always
scripts.release:mac:x64: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env MODE=production pnpm run build && dotenv -e .env -- electron-builder --mac --x64 --config .electron-builder.config.js --publish always
scripts.release:win:x64: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env MODE=production pnpm run build && dotenv -e .env -- electron-builder --win --x64 --config .electron-builder.config.js --publish always
scripts.release:linux:x64: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env MODE=production pnpm run build && dotenv -e .env -- electron-builder --linux --x64 --config .electron-builder.config.js --publish always
scripts.test: pnpm run test:common && pnpm run test:main && pnpm run test:preload && pnpm run test:renderer && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:main && pnpm run typecheck:preload && pnpm run typecheck:renderer
